name: Workspace Icons
author: Adrian Wild
description: Set up your Omarchy workspace bar without touching a config file. Many new Omarchy users struggle to get their top bar and workspaces right; here everything is in one settings popup. Each workspace shows the icons of its apps, including programs in terminals (nvim, claude, tmux) and web apps. Hover to peek at a workspace, click a window to jump to it. Classic, tiles or dots, theme tints, settings per workspace, multi-monitor aware. Swaps in for the stock widget automatically.

barWidget.description: Workspace numbers or dots with the icons of the apps on each workspace, hover previews and one settings popup for everything.

schema.label: Style
schema.description: Classic: numbers with the app icons beside them. Tiles: the same on a rounded tile per workspace. Dots: a dot per workspace, the focused one a pill with its icons.

schema.label: Active tile
schema.description: With the tiles style: the tile of the workspace you're on, brighter (subtle), in the bar's text color (solid) or in the accent color.

schema.label: Focused pill
schema.description: With the dots style: what the focused workspace's pill carries; none leaves a plain pill.

schema.label: Pill frame
schema.description: With the dots style: the filled or outlined shape around the focused workspace's icons and number. Off shows them on the bar itself.

schema.label: Icon opacity
schema.description: Opacity of the app icons; the numbers stay opaque.

schema.label: Colored icons
schema.description: Off tints the icons, see Tint.

schema.label: Gray out other workspaces
schema.description: With colored icons, only the focused workspace's icons are in color.

schema.label: Tint
schema.description: With colored icons off: tint the icons and numbers in the theme's accent color or its normal text color.

schema.label: Color the focused workspace
schema.description: With colored icons off, the focused workspace shows its icons in color instead of the focus mark.

schema.label: Workspace numbers
schema.description: Hides the number on workspaces that have icons.

schema.label: Workspace preview
schema.description: Hover a workspace to see its windows.

schema.label: Live preview
schema.description: Windows in the preview keep updating while it is open.

schema.label: Hide preview while screen sharing
schema.description: No previews while the screen is shared or recorded.

schema.label: Workspaces shown
schema.description: Workspaces shown even when empty; workspaces with windows past this number show too.

schema.label: Hide empty workspaces
schema.description: Only workspaces with windows, and the one each monitor shows.

schema.label: Only this monitor's workspaces
schema.description: Each bar lists the workspaces on its own monitor.

schema.label: Bring workspaces to this monitor
schema.description: Clicking a workspace moves it to the monitor of the bar you clicked.

schema.label: Special workspaces
schema.description: The scratchpad and other special workspaces, while they hold windows.

schema.label: Scroll to switch
schema.description: The mouse wheel over the workspaces moves between them.

schema.label: Scroll wraps around
schema.description: Scrolling past the last workspace goes back to the first.

schema.label: Icon position
schema.description: Icons before or after the workspace number.

schema.label: Show programs in terminals
schema.description: Show the icon of the program running in a terminal (e.g. nvim, btop) instead of the terminal icon.

schema.label: Icons per workspace
schema.description: One icon per distinct app, in window order.

schema.label: Window counts
schema.description: A number on apps with several windows on a workspace.

schema.label: Highlight urgent windows
schema.description: Pulse workspaces whose apps want attention, with a dot on the app.
